title: Kalaam : Meer Kumail Ali
body:
Momino aaj Ali(a.s) ka Maatam hai
Haaye shere khuda ka maatam hai
1. Khaak udhate hain jibraeel e Ameen
Haaye Mushkil Kusha ka Maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Pursa lene ko aayi'n hai Zainab(s.a)
Aaj inke pidar ka Maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Magz tak shaq hua sar e Haider@
Gurbat e Murtaza@ ka Maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ro rahe hain rasool turbat mein
Aaj inke Wasi ka Maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Keh rahe hain Hussain@ Ghazi se
Apne Baba Ali@ ka maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai khuda sogwaar is gham me
Haaye rab ke wali ka Maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Haaye ghamgeen hai khuda ka ghar
Aaj iske makee'n ka maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Khoon rote hain
Meer
pathar bhi
Malik e do jahaa'n ka maatam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Mehwe Maatam hai
Asghari
waale
Aaj moula Ali@ ka maatam hai
Kalaam : Meer Kumail Ali
